name: Saloni Nathani
headline: IDEAS INTO
INTELLIGENCE.
tagline: I turn data, AI research, and reliable software into solutions that help people make better decisions.
about: I'm Saloni Nathani, a software and data professional with a Master of Science in Information Systems from Pace University, where I earned a 4.0/4.0 GPA, the Scholar Award, and a university gold medal.

My experience spans data analytics, scalable Python pipelines, API integration, dashboard development, backend engineering, and technical mentoring. At Kappium, I work across analytical reporting and automated data workflows; previously, I developed reliable software at Tekhnologia Innovations and guided learners at Kalvium.

Beyond professional projects, I explore reinforcement learning, practical NLP, and web intelligence. I have contributed research presented at ICERI and published in IJARSCT, and I enjoy connecting rigorous analysis with systems that are useful in the real world.

projects.title: BioSum Reliable
projects.summary: An evidence-backed biomedical text summarization pipeline combining extractive NLP, entity recognition and transformer-based abstractive generation.
projects.description: BioSum Reliable transforms biomedical research text into structured, interpretable summaries. It blends entity recognition, evidence-ranked extractive summarization and transformer-based abstractive summarization, exposed through a FastAPI service.

projects.title: KPI Decision Agent
projects.summary: A PyTorch Deep Q-Network that learns business decisions in a simulated KPI-driven environment.
projects.description: Built an autonomous reinforcement-learning agent that learns business actions using a Deep Q-Network (DQN). Trained across more than 1,000 episodes, evaluated reward convergence and policy stability, and benchmarked the resulting strategy against rule-based decisions.
highlights: Reward convergence and policy stability analysis

projects.title: Web Trend Intelligence
projects.summary: A live web data pipeline for collecting, analyzing, and visualizing emerging topics over time.
projects.description: Developed a Python pipeline with BeautifulSoup and Pandas to collect and structure live web information. Used text and frequency analysis to identify trending topics and behavioral patterns and visualized their changes across time.

projects.title: NLP Sentiment API
projects.summary: End-to-end text classification and sentiment prediction through a Flask REST API.
projects.description: Designed a Python NLP pipeline that cleans, tokenizes and vectorizes unstructured text with NLTK and spaCy. Trained machine-learning classifiers for text and sentiment predictions and exposed real-time inference through a Flask REST API.

notes.title: Inside BioSum Reliable
notes.summary: How extractive evidence and transformer generation work together in a biomedical summarization pipeline.
paragraphs: BioSum Reliable follows a hybrid design: the system first segments biomedical text, identifies entities and ranks evidence-bearing sentences before producing an extractive summary.

A transformer-based abstractive summarizer then uses the selected material to create a concise result. The output includes structured research sections and surfaced evidence so the result is easier to inspect.
The backend is built with FastAPI and ships with an interactive API reference. See the repository for reproducible setup instructions and implementation details.
